objective: Deliver the sack of murloc heads to Marshall Redpath in Southshore.

description: You know, <name>, I'd really rather not take these heads... Since you've already got a handle on them, would you mind delivering them to Redpath for me?
progress: Greetings, citizen. Have you come to lend your arm to upholding the safety of Southshore?
completion: If you assisted Farren in procuring these heads, then thank you. Southshore needs hard workers and effort to maintain its protection.
